description: Réseau et schéma cyclable métropolitain is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Ce jeu de données rassemble les informations sur les typologies d'aménagement cyclable existant et projeté sur le territoire Métropolitain. Un champ de donnée renseigne sur la typologie d'aménagement existant. Un autre champ renseigne sur la typologie d'aménagement projeté. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are réseau cyclable, vélo, schéma cyclable, cycle, piste, aménagement. The portal shows 1,275 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
